propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at 32767 chars while jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable (0 to 2147483647), causing silent data loss when an admin raises the limit

sanitize_comment and fit_comment incorrectly depend on the description fitter (fit_outbound) instead of having their own DC-specific truncation rule, creating a coupling hazard where future description fitter changes could retarget comments incorrectly
the DC comment ceiling is now configurable via ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars with default 32767 and range 0-2147483647, matching jira.text.field.character.limit's documented scope

sanitize_comment and fit_comment are decoupled from the description fitter and both route through _truncate_dc_comment_body, ensuring structural convergence between send-side and differ-side transforms
auto-discovery of the ceiling from /rest/api/2/application-properties is dropped because the endpoint requires Administer Jira permission while rebar authenticates as an ordinary user
